elements.label: About
elements.value: Controls the camera's orbit position: how far back and how high above the character it sits.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/view_distance.schema.json, set vd_c_style to {{vd_c_style}}]
Set camera framing to {{vd_c_style}} by adjusting ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderOffset.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/view_distance.schema.json, set vd_t_distance to {{vd_t_distance}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.targetDistance to {{vd_t_distance}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/view_distance.schema.json, set vd_t_height to {{vd_t_height}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderHeight to {{vd_t_height}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/view_distance.schema.json, set vd_t_offset to {{vd_t_offset}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderOffset to {{vd_t_offset}}. Positive=right, Negative=left.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/view_distance.schema.json, set vd_t_fov to {{vd_t_fov}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.fieldOfView to {{vd_t_fov}} degrees.
